BiblicalUsage: The word means fourfold, and it appears once, when Nathan tells David the rich man must restore the poor man's lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and had no pity.
TheologicalSignificance: Fourfold is the law's arithmetic for a theft without pity, and David pronounces his own sentence before he knows it.
